title: Personal Credit Cards: late fee and returned payment fee amounts by tier
content:
# Personal Credit Cards: late fee and returned payment fee amounts

This fee card covers the Personal Credit Cards line and gives, for every card tier, the late fee charged when no earlier late fee is found in the look-back cycles, the late fee charged when one is found, how many preceding statement cycles are searched, and the fee charged when a payment is returned unpaid.

## Fee table

| Card tier | Late fee, no earlier late fee in the look-back | Late fee, earlier late fee found in the look-back | Look-back (preceding statement cycles) | Returned payment fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Secured Visa | 29.00 USD | 40.00 USD | 6 cycles | 29.00 USD |
| College Rewards Visa | 25.00 USD | 25.00 USD | 6 cycles | 25.00 USD |
| Platinum Low Rate Visa | 32.00 USD | 41.00 USD | 6 cycles | 32.00 USD |
| Cash Rewards Visa | 32.00 USD | 41.00 USD | 6 cycles | 32.00 USD |
| Travel Rewards Visa Signature | 32.00 USD | 41.00 USD | 6 cycles | 32.00 USD |
| Visa Infinite Private Client | 32.00 USD | 41.00 USD | 6 cycles | 32.00 USD |

## What the columns mean

- **First late fee**: the late fee when no late fee was charged in the look-back cycles.
- **Repeat late fee**: the late fee when a late fee was charged in any of the look-back cycles.
- **Look-back**: the number of preceding statement cycles searched for an earlier late fee.
- **Returned payment fee**: the fee when a payment is returned unpaid.

## Equivalent reading

- On College Rewards Visa the first and the repeat late fee are the same amount, so an earlier late fee in the look-back does not change the figure on that tier.
- On every other tier the repeat late fee is higher than the first late fee.

## Basis Q&A

**Q: On a Secured Visa, which figure applies when a late fee was charged in one of the 6 preceding cycles?**
A: The repeat late fee of 40.00 USD.

**Q: On a Secured Visa, which figure applies when none of the 6 preceding cycles carried a late fee?**
A: The first late fee of 29.00 USD.
